question: Should plain `birdclaw init` implicitly query xurl and adopt its default OAuth identity, or must authenticated account adoption remain explicitly requested?
rationale: The proposed default changes an established local initialization boundary and can mutate persisted account ownership based on external auth state, so the permanent CLI contract requires explicit product intent.

options.title: Require explicit account selection
options.body: Run authenticated lookup only when `--account <username>` is supplied, leaving plain initialization local and deterministic.

options.title: Approve implicit adoption
options.body: Allow plain initialization to adopt xurl’s default account, but require explicit documentation and real fresh-install and upgrade proof for multi-account and unavailable-xurl cases.

recommendation.title: Require explicit account selection
recommendation.body: Run authenticated lookup only when `--account <username>` is supplied, leaving plain initialization local and deterministic.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the repository creator and strongest available owner of the documented local-first CLI boundary.
